title: Impossible to figure out
text: Impossible to figure out. It looks OK but good luck trying to get it to work. It has some kind of automatic shut off feature so it stops displaying the time after about a minute. I have no idea who thought it was a good idea to make a clock that shuts off and cannot be read but that’s really the main function of a clock.  I somehow got it to work but then I went to change the time due to daylight savings time and now it won’t display the time.  Also, like just about every other product on Amazon you have to have been born in China to understand the directions that come with it.
